name: STDEVA
description: STDEVA estimates the sample standard deviation (n-1) while treating text as 0 and logical values TRUE as 1 and FALSE as 0.
tldr: Sample standard deviation that also counts text and logicals as numbers.

parameters.name: value1
parameters.description: The first value, range, or reference in the sample.

basicExample.description: Sample standard deviation of numeric values only
basicExample.explanation: With only numbers present, STDEVA returns the same result as STDEV.

advancedExamples.title: Text and TRUE are counted
advancedExamples.scenario: A range that mixes numbers, text, and a logical
advancedExamples.description: Text becomes 0 and TRUE becomes 1 before the calculation
advancedExamples.explanation: The values used are 10,20,30,1,0; the mean is 12.2, the sample variance is 164.2, and the square root is 12.8156046.

advancedExamples.title: Contrast with STDEV on a reference
advancedExamples.description: STDEV ignores text and logicals inside a range
advancedExamples.explanation: STDEV sees only 10,20,30 (n=3) and returns 10, whereas STDEVA counts all five values.

howItWorks: STDEVA first coerces every argument to a number: numbers stay as-is, text (including empty text "") becomes 0, TRUE becomes 1 and FALSE becomes 0. It then computes the sample standard deviation with the n-1 denominator, so non-numeric entries increase both the sum and the count.

howToSteps.name: Identify values
howToSteps.text: Collect the values, including any text or logicals you want counted.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The sample standard deviation including non-numerics is shown.

limitations: Counting text as 0 can distort the result if text cells are merely labels, not true zero measurements.
Still requires at least two effective values, otherwise returns #DIV/0!.
The n-1 denominator still assumes a sample, not a full population (use STDEVPA for population).

commonErrors.cause: Fewer than two effective numeric values after coercion.
commonErrors.fix: Provide at least two values that evaluate to numbers.

commonErrors.cause: Text labels were coerced to 0, pulling the mean down.
commonErrors.fix: Use STDEV when text cells should be ignored.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: STDEVA is available in Google Sheets with the same coercion rules.

faq.question: Does STDEVA treat empty cells as 0?
faq.answer: No. Empty cells are ignored; only text and logicals are coerced (text to 0, TRUE to 1, FALSE to 0).

faq.question: When should I use STDEVA instead of STDEV?
faq.answer: When your data includes logicals or text that genuinely represent 1/0 or zero, and you want them in the sample.

faq.question: What is the population equivalent?
faq.answer: STDEVPA, which uses the n denominator instead of n-1.
